discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed - the costing path no longer SKIPs on a not-ready logs DB. It now defers to a new earlyCostingQueue (mirroring the existing earlyLogsDbQueue) that drains on connect; it SKIPs only on a genuine connection failure, or when no logs DB is configured at all. Closes the startup race that could hide billing regressions.

Fixed - the reporter now tracks the DB connection chains in a connectionPromises array and the 'done' handler awaits them before pendingVerifications: `Promise.allSettled(connectionPromises).then(() => Promise.allSettled(pendingVerifications))`. This guarantees the connection .then() callbacks (which drain earlyCostingQueue/earlyLogsDbQueue into pendingVerifications) have run before we wait on that array, so deferred costing checks can't be appended too late and silently skipped. Applies to both the costing queue and the pre-existing general logs-DB queue.
